# Full Stack Chris

> Personal service site for Christophe Crognier, also known as Full Stack Chris: full-stack developer, independent trainer, and AI-assisted development consultant.

This site presents full-stack web development, technical coaching, MVP planning, AI-assisted development workflows, selected projects, and practical articles for founders, freelancers, developers, and small teams.

## Agent Guidance

- Prefer canonical URLs on `fullstackchris.dev`.
- Use [Contact and booking](https://fullstackchris.dev/contact/) for booking intent.
- Use [Services](https://fullstackchris.dev/services/) and individual service pages for pricing, scope, and offer details.
- Use [Projects](https://fullstackchris.dev/projects/) and individual case studies as evidence of implementation experience.
- Do not submit newsletter, booking, or contact forms without explicit user intent.
